description: This file defines an abstract class `LayoutSupport` that provides methods for managing and retrieving layout templates based on various criteria such as name, code, country, and display name. It also manages special tokens and default layout format.

classes.name: LayoutSupport
classes.description: An abstract class that manages layout templates and provides retrieval methods based on different identifiers.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplates
methods.description: Returns the list of layout templates.

methods.name: setLayoutTemplates
methods.description: Sets the list of layout templates.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutTemplate
methods.description: Returns the default layout template based on the default layout format.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByName
methods.description: Finds a layout template by its display name, code name, or country.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByCodeName
methods.description: Finds a layout template by its code name.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByCountry
methods.description: Finds a layout template by its country.

methods.name: getLayoutTemplateByDisplayName
methods.description: Finds a layout template by its display name.

methods.name: getSpecialTokens
methods.description: Returns the list of special tokens.

methods.name: setSpecialTokens
methods.description: Sets the list of special tokens.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutFormat
methods.description: Returns the default layout format (abstract method).
